roots.name: VHH::Tool::LB_locator_transform
roots.documentation:
### ***LB_locator_transform*** **Component Compound** - this compound is a component in the the LightBox system.

**LB_locator_transform** - this is a simple compound that converts an incoming world matrix to a position and direction vector - these are used in the lights.

*** ## Input ***locator_matrix_in***
The incoming matrix. *** ## Output ***position***
The position vector. ***direction***
The direction vector.
